_comment: DeepSeek Harness worker launch config TEMPLATE (PLACEHOLDER). The real deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime worker binary is NOT present in this environment, so AIOS_DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_ENABLED must stay false until a worker exists. To activate: (1) obtain the harness SDK runtime that speaks aios.worker/v1 (serverInfo.name == 'deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime'); (2) fill command/cwd/manifest/manifest_sha256/active_plugins below; (3) export AIOS_DEEPSEEK_HARNESS_ENABLED=true and AIOS_AGENT_API_KEY; (4) register an agent with config_ref='deepseek-harness+file://<this file>' and secret_ref='env://AIOS_AGENT_API_KEY'. The harness path is fail-closed: any malformed config raises HarnessTransportError instead of silently falling back.
